full_judgment: 8. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the Courts below have committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in misreading and non-considering the evidence on record and erroneously dismissed the suit. He next submits that the Courts below failed to hold that Abdul Mannan, predecessor of the plaintiffs, was the owner and possessor of the suit property from whom the plaintiff purchased the same and were owing and possessing the suit property which is beyond the periphery of Dhalauri hat. He also submits that Dhalauri hat has enough land and the suit property is out side the boundary of the Dhalauri hat and it belongs to private persons and not to the Government.
